paper_title: Search for Axion dark matter with the QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, 90% C.L. single-sided upper limit as plotted
notes: QUAX-LNF tunable haloscope first run: excludes axion DM with g_agamma down to 0.882e-13 GeV^-1 (paper body; abstract v3 header says 0.861e-13 but the text consistently states 0.882e-13) over 36.52413-36.5511 ueV at 90% CL. Full limit curve only in Fig. 7 (not tabulated); the two points represent the best (deepest) limit as a flat line over the scanned mass window; actual limit fluctuates upward around this value. Assumes rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and standard halo model. Paper also recasts as dark photon kinetic mixing chi (Fig. 8, random polarization, cos theta = 1/sqrt(3)) but the primary result is the axion-photon coupling. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 57)) | Vision: Fig. 7 (top) of the QUAX-LNF paper: 90% C.L. upper limit on axion-photon coupling over 36.52413-36.5511 ueV (8.831496-8.83803 GHz). The limit is a rapidly fluctuating jagged curve; individual spike positions are approximate, but the overall envelope (dips ~0.9-1.2e-13, peaks ~2-3e-13, edges rising to ~1e-12) is faithful. Best sensitivity 0.882e-13 GeV^-1 at 36.53764 ueV taken from text. KSVZ benchmark line lies at ~1.4e-14 GeV^-1, consistent with text stating the limit is ~6x above KSVZ.
